ei.title: The Ulysses Contract to Break Habits
ei.subject: 11월_2022 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: The Ulysses Contract to Break Habits

fullPassage: If you've ever made a poor choice, you might be interested in learning how to break that habit. One great way to trick your brain into doing so is to sign a "Ulysses Contract." The name of this life tip comes from the Greek myth about Ulysses, a captain whose ship sailed past the island of the Sirens, a tribe of dangerous women who lured victims to their death with their irresistible songs. Knowing that he would otherwise be unable to resist, Ulysses instructed his crew to stuff their ears with cotton and tie him to the ship's mast to prevent him from turning their ship towards the Sirens. It worked for him and you can do the same thing by locking yourself out of your temptations. For example, if you want to stay off your cellphone and concentrate on your work, delete the apps that distract you or ask a friend to change your password!

questions.passage: If you've ever made a (A)[poor / wise] choice, you might be interested in learning how to break that habit. One great way to trick your brain into doing so is to sign a "Ulysses Contract." The name of this life tip comes from the Greek myth about Ulysses, a captain whose ship sailed past the island of the Sirens, a tribe of (B)[friendly / dangerous] women who lured victims to their death with their irresistible songs. Knowing that he would otherwise be unable to resist, Ulysses instructed his crew to stuff their ears with cotton and tie him to the ship's mast to prevent him from turning their ship towards the Sirens. It (C)[worked / failed] for him and you can do the same thing by locking yourself out of your temptations. For example, if you want to stay off your cellphone and concentrate on your work, delete the apps that distract you or ask a friend to change your password!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① wise - dangerous - worked: (A) wise(현명한)는 '좋지 않은 선택을 한 적이 있다면'이라는 문맥에 반대
✅ ② poor - dangerous - worked: 좋지 않은(poor) 선택, 위험한(dangerous) 여자들, 그에게 효과가 있었다(worked). 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ poor - friendly - worked: (B) friendly(친절한)는 '사람을 죽음으로 유인한 위험한 여자들'과 반대
❌ ④ poor - dangerous - failed: (C) failed(실패했다)는 'It worked for him(그에게 효과가 있었다)'과 반대
det.tip: poor choice(좋지 않은 선택) → dangerous women(위험한 여자들) → It worked(효과가 있었다)

questions.passage: If you've ever made a poor choice, you might be interested in learning how to (A)[break / form] that habit. One great way to trick your brain into doing so is to sign a "Ulysses Contract." The name of this life tip comes from the Greek myth about Ulysses, a captain whose ship sailed past the island of the Sirens, a tribe of dangerous women who (B)[rescued / lured] victims to their death with their irresistible songs. Knowing that he would otherwise be unable to resist, Ulysses instructed his crew to stuff their ears with cotton and tie him to the ship's mast to (C)[prevent / allow] him from turning their ship towards the Sirens. It worked for him and you can do the same thing by locking yourself out of your temptations. For example, if you want to stay off your cellphone and concentrate on your work, delete the apps that distract you or ask a friend to change your password!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① form - lured - prevent: (A) form(형성하다)은 '나쁜 습관을 깨는 법'이라는 문맥에 반대
❌ ② break - rescued - prevent: (B) rescued(구출했다)는 '희생자를 죽음으로 유인했다'와 반대
✅ ③ break - lured - prevent: 습관을 깨다(break), 유인했다(lured), 막다(prevent). 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ break - lured - allow: (C) allow(허락하다)는 '배가 방향을 트는 것을 막다'와 반대
det.tip: break that habit(습관을 깨다) → lured victims(유인했다) → prevent him(막다)

The name of this life tip comes from the Greek myth about Ulysses, a captain whose ship sailed past the island of the Sirens, a tribe of dangerous women who lured victims to their death with their (A)[irresistible / unpleasant] songs. Knowing that he would otherwise be unable to resist, Ulysses instructed his crew to stuff their ears with cotton and (B)[free / tie] him to the ship's mast to prevent him from turning their ship towards the Sirens. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① irresistible - tie - delete: 거부할 수 없는(irresistible) 노래, 그를 묶다(tie), 앱을 삭제하다(delete). 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② unpleasant - tie - delete: (A) unpleasant(불쾌한)는 '희생자를 유인한 매혹적인 노래'와 반대
❌ ③ irresistible - free - delete: (B) free(풀어주다)는 '그를 돛대에 묶다'와 반대
❌ ④ irresistible - tie - keep: (C) keep(유지하다)은 '방해되는 앱을 삭제하라'와 반대
det.tip: irresistible songs(거부할 수 없는 노래) → tie him(묶다) → delete the apps(삭제하다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 명사 danger → 형용사 dangerous (뒤의 명사 women을 꾸밈)
det.analysis: 명사 danger(위험)를 형용사 dangerous(위험한)로 바꿔야 해요. 바로 뒤의 명사 women(여자들)을 앞에서 꾸며주는 자리이기 때문에 형용사가 필요합니다. 'a tribe of dangerous women'은 '위험한 여자들의 무리'라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: danger(명사) → dangerous(형용사). 명사 앞에서 꾸며주면 형용사

questions.passage: It worked for him and you can do the same thing by __________ (lock) yourself out of your temptations. For example, if you want to stay off your cellphone and concentrate on your work, delete the apps that distract you or ask a friend to change your password!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사가 와요. lock → locking
det.analysis: 전치사 by(~함으로써) 뒤에는 동사를 그대로 쓸 수 없고, 동사 뒤에 -ing를 붙인 동명사 형태를 써야 해요. 그래서 lock을 locking으로 바꿉니다. 'by locking yourself out of your temptations'는 '스스로를 유혹에서 차단함으로써'라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: 전치사(by) + 동명사(-ing). lock → locking

questions.passage: If you've ever made a poor choice, you might be interested in learning how to break that habit. One great way to trick your brain into doing so is to sign a "Ulysses Contract." The name of this life tip comes from the Greek myth about Ulysses, a captain whose ship sailed past the island of the Sirens, a tribe of dangerous women who lured victims to their death with their irresistible songs. Knowing that he would otherwise be unable to resist, Ulysses instructed his crew to __________ and tie him to the ship's mast to prevent him from turning their ship towards the Sirens. It worked for him and you can do the same thing by locking yourself out of your temptations. For example, if you want to stay off your cellphone and concentrate on your work, delete the apps that distract you or ask a friend to change your password!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① sail past the dangerous island: 세이렌의 노래를 못 듣게 하려는 조치가 아님
✅ ② stuff their ears with cotton: 세이렌의 매혹적인 노래를 듣지 못하도록 귀를 솜으로 막게 함 ←정답
❌ ③ sing along with the Sirens: 노래에 유혹되는 것을 막으려는 의도와 반대
❌ ④ jump into the deep sea: 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: instructed his crew to ______ → stuff their ears with cotton (귀를 솜으로 막다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 배가 세이렌 쪽으로 방향을 트는 것을 막기 위해
det.analysis:
❌ ① hearing the ocean waves clearly: 막으려는 대상이 아님
❌ ② sailing back to his home country: 본문에 없는 내용
❌ ③ resting on the wooden deck: 본문에 없는 내용
✅ ④ turning their ship towards the Sirens: 자신을 돛대에 묶은 이유는 배를 세이렌 쪽으로 돌리지 못하게 하기 위함 ←정답
det.tip: prevent him from ______ → turning their ship towards the Sirens (세이렌 쪽으로 배를 돌리다)
